name: mem_timeline
description: Show chronological context around a specific observation. Use after mem_search to drill into the timeline of events surrounding a search result. This is the progressive disclosure pattern: search first, then timeline to understand context.

after.description: Number of observations to show after the focus (default: 5)

before.description: Number of observations to show before the focus (default: 5)

observation_id.description: The observation ID to center the timeline on (from mem_search results)

project.description: Filter by project name (omit for auto-detect)
